messages:
Nora F: Quick follow-up from yesterday's tokenization outage. We promised concrete remediation tests. Need owners for: expanded regression prompts, a focused tokenization eval, a nightly soak with telemetry guards, a small chaos drill (KV-GC pause + worker recycle), and a deterministic replay harness.
Diego L: I'll own the regression prompt expansion and the tokenization eval. Plan: pull incident prompts, dedupe, add ~180 adversarial cases, and tag them incident-origin. Will produce prompt json + eval harness PR by Mon EOD.
Ivy K: I'll take the nightly soak + replay harness. Soak plan: 90m at 160rps on staging with a 12m 3x spike in the middle. Replay harness should accept a log fragment and replay deterministically. ETA infra PR by Wed.
Nora F: For the chaos drill, we want a small, scoped exercise: KV-GC pause for 90s followed by a single worker recycle. Schedule non-business hours and SRE observe. Who can coordinate with SRE?
platform-bot: Created ticket PLAT-6120 "Post-incident: tests, evals, chaos" and added Nora F, Diego L, Ivy K as assignees. Link: https://redwood.internal/PLAT-6120
Diego L: Acceptance criteria draft: regression = no >1.5% drop in primary quality metric on adversarial bucket; tokenization eval = <0.5% increase in tokenization errors; soak = p95 < 200ms and retries <0.3%; chaos = recovery within 15m with no persistent KV inconsistencies. If any criterion fails, mark PLAT-6120 blocker and start an annex.
Ivy K: Telemetry guards: fail soak if token-rate surge >30% for >2m or kv_gc_pause_ms > 4000. Will add dashboard panels and a CI hard-fail if guards trip.
Nora F: Owners recap: Diego = prompts + tokenization eval (PR Mon), Ivy = soak + replay + infra (PR Wed), Nora = runbook, chaos coordination, and customer comms. I'll draft the one-paragraph customer blurb to send after the run.
Diego L: I'll also include a small deterministic replay script to replay the exact sequence that triggered the incident; helps debugging.
Ivy K: Scheduling ask: propose chaos window Sat 02:00 UTC to minimize staging traffic. Will confirm with SRE and add calendar invite.
platform-bot: Linked PLAT-6120 to SRE-4988 and scheduled planning sync Tue 16:00 UTC.
Nora F: Thanks everyone. Please update PLAT-6120 with PR links and any slips. I'll post a short run summary here after the first successful run. :white_check_mark:
